Tooltip_BF_SeringaVazia: Clean syringe. Base for every injectable.
Tooltip_BF_SeringaUsada: Must be sterilized with alcohol before reuse.
Tooltip_BF_Monjaro: 24 h. Faster weight loss, 30% less hunger. <LINE> Side effect: tires 25% faster.
Tooltip_BF_Ozempic: 24 h. Faster weight loss, 20% less hunger. <LINE> Side effect: tires 15% faster.
Tooltip_BF_Deca: 48 h. +15% strength (carry weight and melee damage). <LINE> Side effect: hunger 40% faster.
Tooltip_BF_Trembolona: 36 h. +10% strength (carry weight and melee damage). <LINE> Side effect: hunger 30% faster.
Tooltip_BF_Morfina: 8 h. Cuts 80% of pain and relieves muscle strain. <LINE> From the 3rd dose: paranoia (phantom zombie sounds) and growing depression.
Tooltip_BF_Adrenalina: 1 h. Near infinite stamina, keen hearing, cuts panic. <LINE> Afterwards: extreme tiredness and, for 2 h, cuts bleed 50% more.
Tooltip_BF_Rebite: 6 h. Tires 80% less. <LINE> Afterwards: for 6 h sleep recovers only half the tiredness.
Tooltip_BF_Dipirona: 4 h. Relieves muscle strain and 30% of pain.
Tooltip_BF_Metanfetamina: 6 h. Removes muscle strain fast and tires 50% less. <LINE> Paranoia from the 1st dose. From the 3rd dose it is addictive: 24 h without a dose = withdrawal. Clean after 5 days.
Tooltip_BF_Tadala: 6 h. Relieves muscle strain. <LINE> Afterwards: extreme sadness.
Tooltip_BF_Benegripe: Cures a cold instantly and prevents a new one for 12 h.
Tooltip_BF_Lolo: Solvent-soaked rag, 5 sniffs. Kills nicotine craving and relieves stress. <LINE> Causes nausea and drunkenness.
Tooltip_BF_BenegripeForte: Cures a cold instantly and prevents a new one for 36 h.
Tooltip_BF_VitaminaC: 6 h cold protection and a little less tiredness. Weaker than pharmacy vitamins.
Tooltip_BF_Creatina: 6 h. +50% Strength XP. No side effects.
Tooltip_BF_Whey: 6 h. +50% Fitness XP and reduces hunger a bit. No side effects.
Tooltip_BF_KitAntidoping: Use on another player (right click them) to see what they took in the last 48 h. Consumes the kit.
Tooltip_BF_Vidraria: Flasks, hose and funnel. Needed for Morphine, Deca and Meth, and to build the lab bench.
Tooltip_BF_Laboratorio: Bench with microscope. Morphine, Deca and Meth can only be prepared within 3 tiles of it.
Tooltip_BF_LivroHorta: Teaches the growing seasons of medicinal herbs. Readers harvest one extra herb per plant and earn Pharmacy XP.
